result.title: LoopPrune: Recurrent Pruning for Looped Diffusion Transformers
result.summary: Looped diffusion Transformers reuse shared blocks to deepen computation and match larger models with fewer parameters, reducing storage and deployment burdens. Yet repeated attention and MLP computations remain costly. Pruning reduces storage and computation by removing redundant parameters or units. Training-free methods struggle to resolve recurrent contributions, while training-based methods lack explicit constraints on position-specific errors affecting later inputs and final outputs. We propose LoopPrune, a pruning and recovery framework addressing these requirements. Recurrent importance estimation combines shared-removal effects and position variation to select a shared structure; shared reconstruction pools recurrent input statistics to compensate weights. Loop-position recovery compares complete denoising predictions at identical student states and matches text guidance, updating all student parameters against a fixed dense teacher. Extensive experiments across four open-source models, six benchmarks, and three pruning paradigms demonstrate effectiveness. At 30% structured parameter pruning, Looped-DiT B/16 retains 93.14% of dense six-benchmark average accuracy, exceeding the best baseline by 9.49%. Across PyTorch, vLLM-Omni, and SGLang Diffusion, pruned SDXSv3 reduces peak allocated GPU memory by 34.36-44.64% and accelerates denoising 1.46-1.74x over dense models.

AI.brief_summary: LoopPrune 研究循环复用共享块的扩散 Transformer 的结构化剪枝，提出结合共享移除效应与循环位置差异的重要性估计，以及逐循环位置的恢复训练，并在四个开源模型上评估精度保持与显存、去噪速度收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文区分「共享移除效应」与「循环位置差异」来归因循环迭代的贡献、并按位置恢复，可能为 looped latent reasoning 中按迭代分配参数容量与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但其属图像生成剪枝，迁移需自行判断。
